vocabulary.note_ar: everyday كلمة واحدة صفة: everyday life
vocabulary.note_en: "Everyday" (one word) is an adjective: everyday life.
vocabulary.example: What do you do every day?

fine_lines.title: go home / go to work
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نقول go to work و go to school مع to، لكن go home بدون to.
fine_lines.explanation_en: We say "go to work" but "go home" (no "to").

examples.sentence: I go to work by bus.

fine_lines.title: eat / have
fine_lines.explanation_ar: مع الوجبات يمكن استخدام eat أو have: eat breakfast = have breakfast. ومع shower نستخدم have (بريطانية) أو take (أمريكية)، ولا نستخدم eat.
fine_lines.explanation_en: With meals you can say "eat" or "have". With a shower, use "have" (UK) or "take" (US).

examples.sentence: I have a shower and have breakfast.

fine_lines.title: listen to / hear
fine_lines.explanation_ar: listen to تعني الاستماع بانتباه وقصد، أما hear فتعني سماع الصوت دون قصد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Listen to" is on purpose; "hear" is when a sound comes to your ears.

examples.sentence: I listen to the radio on the bus.

expressions.phrase: What do you do every day?
expressions.example: What do you do every day? - I wake up and eat breakfast.
I wake up at six thirty.

expressions.phrase: I get the bus to work.
expressions.example: I get the bus / drive / walk to work.
I listen to the news or a podcast.

expressions.phrase: After I finish work, I swim in the sea.
expressions.meaning_ar: بعد أن أنهي العمل أسبح في البحر.
expressions.meaning_en: say what you do after work
expressions.example: After I finish work, I go to the gym.
I have a shower before bed.
I go to sleep at ten.

grammar.title: Present simple for routines
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للأشياء التي نفعلها كل يوم: I wake up, I eat, I go. مع he/she/it نضيف s: He wakes up. She goes.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present simple for things you do every day. Add -s with he/she/it.
examples: She goes to work by bus.
He watches a film in the evening.

grammar.title: Ordering your day: after
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم after لترتيب الأحداث: After I finish work, I swim. يمكن أيضًا استخدام then: I eat lunch, then I go home.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "after" and "then" to put your day in order.
examples: After I finish work, I swim in the sea.
I eat breakfast, then I go to work.

questions.question: What do you do ___ day?
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الصحيح every day = كل يوم.

questions.question: She ___ to work.
questions.explanation_ar: مع she نضيف s في المضارع البسيط.
questions.explanation_en: With "she" add -s in the present simple.

questions.question: I listen ___ the radio on the bus.
Choose the correct sentence.
choices: After I finish work, I swim.
After I finishing work, I swim.
questions.explanation_ar: after + فاعل + فعل: After I finish work.

questions.question: Which is the last thing in the day?
questions.explanation_ar: go to sleep = النوم في آخر اليوم.
questions.explanation_en: "Go to sleep" is at the end of the day.

questions.explanation_ar: podcast تسجيل صوتي تستمع إليه عبر الإنترنت.
questions.explanation_en: A podcast is a recorded talk you listen to online.
